industries.name: Hair removal and shaving

brands.name: Venus
brands.description: Gillette's razor and hair-removal brand for women, owned by Procter & Gamble.

brands.name: Estrid
brands.description: Swedish direct-to-consumer razor brand sold mainly by subscription, known for pastel handles and vegan positioning.

brands.name: Veet
brands.description: Hair-removal creams, wax strips and trimmers from Reckitt.

brands.name: Philips OneBlade
brands.description: Philips' hybrid electric trimmer and shaver, tracked here for its intimate and female range.

brands.name: Wilkinson Sword

brands.name: Mercadona
brands.description: Spanish supermarket chain. Its own-label hair-removal products appear in creator hauls.

industries.name: Electric vehicles, Europe

brands.name: Tesla
brands.description: US electric-vehicle maker and the reference brand for the category.

brands.name: BYD

brands.name: MG (SAIC)

brands.name: Skoda
brands.description: Czech car maker in the Volkswagen Group. The Enyaq and Elroq are its electric models.

brands.name: Renault
brands.description: French car maker with a long-running electric range, including the Renault 5 E-Tech.

brands.name: Kia
brands.description: Korean car maker. Its EV range runs from the EV3 to the EV9.

brands.name: BMW
brands.description: German premium car maker. Its electric models carry the i badge.

brands.name: Polestar
brands.description: Swedish electric performance car brand with roots in Volvo and Geely.

brands.name: Leapmotor
brands.description: Chinese electric-vehicle maker sold in Europe through a joint venture with Stellantis.

brands.name: Zeekr
brands.description: Premium electric brand from China's Geely group, entering European markets.

brands.name: Mercedes-Benz
brands.description: German premium car maker. Its electric models are sold under EQ and electric versions of its core lines.

brands.name: Volvo

brands.name: Hyundai
brands.description: Korean car maker. The IONIQ line is its electric range.

brands.name: EV market in the EU
brands.description: The wider conversation about electric vehicles in the EU, not tied to one brand. Useful as a market baseline, not as a competitor.

brands.description: Caribbean destination known for Punta Cana's all-inclusive resorts, beaches and golf.

brands.name: Mexico

brands.name: Jamaica

brands.name: Aruba

brands.name: Puerto Rico

brands.name: Costa Rica
brands.description: Central American destination known for eco-tourism, rainforest and surf.

brands.name: Turks & Caicos
brands.description: Luxury beach destination centred on Grace Bay in Providenciales.

brands.name: U.S. Virgin Islands

brands.name: Cayman Islands
brands.description: British territory known for Seven Mile Beach, diving and upmarket stays.

brands.name: Barbados

brands.name: St. Lucia
brands.description: Eastern Caribbean island known for the Pitons and honeymoon resorts.

brands.name: Curaçao
brands.description: Dutch Caribbean island known for Willemstad's waterfront and diving.

brands.name: Belize

brands.name: Colombia
brands.description: South American destination: Cartagena, Medellín and the Caribbean coast.

brands.name: St. Martin
brands.description: Island shared by France and the Netherlands, known for beaches and dining.
